title: Pink Sorority Girl Halloween Costume
intro: The easiest costume of the season is a cropped pink hoodie, a tennis skirt and a pair of striped knee socks. Add platform high tops and a canvas tote and you are ready for a campus party. Everything works again for fall weekends.

sections.heading: Five pieces and you are dressed
paragraphs: This is the costume for the person who forgot Halloween was this weekend. Cropped pink hoodie, pleated tennis skirt, striped knee socks, platform high tops, canvas tote. You can see the whole set in the flat lay on the pink satin, the hoodie up top with the skirt tucked right under it like an actual outfit, which it is.

The cropped hoodie is soft pastel pink with a drawstring and a front pocket. Cropped matters here. It hits right at the waistband of the skirt, so the two read as one outfit instead of a sweatshirt swallowing a skirt. Check the size chart on the listing for length, and if you like a little more coverage, go up one size.

The whole point of this one is comfort. No corset, no heels, no wig, nothing to adjust every ten minutes. You can sit on the floor at a party, walk across a quad and climb into the back seat of somebody's car without thinking about it once. That alone puts it ahead of most costumes I have worn.

sections.heading: The skirt has pockets
paragraphs: The pink pleated tennis skirt has pockets. That is the sentence. Phone in one, lip gloss in the other, and your hands are free. It has a wide waistband that sits high, which makes your legs look longer with the socks. Check the listing to see if it has shorts built in, and if not, wear bike shorts underneath for any party where you will be sitting on stairs.

The pink and white striped knee high socks are what make this a costume and not just a Saturday. Pull them all the way up, right under the knee. In the campus photo you can see them from the back with the stripes lined up at the top. If yours slide down, a strip of body tape at the cuff holds them in place.

sections.heading: Shoes you can walk a whole campus in
paragraphs: The pink platform canvas high tops are the reason you can do a party, a walk home and a diner after. Lace them snug at the ankle so they do not flop around on the platform. Canvas sneakers can run narrow or long, so read the sizing notes on the listing and what reviewers say about fit before you order your usual size.

The pink canvas tote with the zipper is the grown up version of a backpack. It holds a jacket for later, a water bottle and whatever else the night needs, and the zipper means nothing falls out on the walk. Wear it over one shoulder like I am in the photo, walking away down the brick path through the leaves with an iced coffee in my other hand.

sections.heading: After the party, it is just fall clothes
paragraphs: Hair is easy. Big loose waves, or a high ponytail if you want it a little sportier. Pink gloss, a little blush, done. You do not need a full face for this one, the outfit is doing the talking. The bow, tulips, lip gloss, candle and iced coffee in the flat lay are styling extras, not part of the list.

That campus shot was a chilly fall afternoon, and the hoodie was exactly enough. The socks helped more than I expected. Budget wise, you probably own a hoodie and white sneakers already, so the skirt and the socks are the two pieces doing the work. After Halloween, the whole thing goes straight back into fall weekends.
